scope: Read-only paid model experiments; no deployment, database or Telegram mutations.

interpretation.development: Threshold sweeps reuse full-batch Gemini predictions; counterfactual only.
interpretation.validation: Actual sequential Clef then Gemini on residual inputs, paired with Gemini on all inputs.
interpretation.thresholds: 0.99 primary; 0.95 secondary selected from development before validation.
interpretation.attribution: Only early-stage changes are direct Clef gains/errors. Identical-input fallback differences are Gemini A/A variation; reduced-batch differences are composition or sampling effects.
interpretation.latency: Case-weighted batch request duration, early=Clef, remaining=Clef+Gemini. Excludes rate-limit waits; repeated cases are not independent latency samples.
interpretation.cost: Provider-reported USD receipts including observed price/cache variation; excludes earlier investigation and separate smoke probe.
interpretation.labels: Synthetic intended behavior, frozen before development results; repeated orders are robustness tests, not fresh independent production observations.
